title: The Four Horsemen of Revelation
description: When the Lamb opens the first four of the seven seals, the living creatures call forth four horsemen: one on a white horse with a bow and crown who goes out to conquer, one on a fiery red horse who takes peace from the earth, one on a black horse with scales who brings famine, and one on a pale green horse – Death – who, along with Hades, is given power over a fourth of the earth.

versions.title: The Four Horsemen of Revelation
versions.description: John sees in a vision four horsemen riding out when the first four seals are opened – they symbolize conquest, war, famine, and death.
versions.reason: [major] category: The category 'paulus' is incorrect. Revelation was not written by Paul. It should be 'urkirken' as the closest suitable category.
